statements.t: “AI is the most transformational game changer to come along in a generation, and we expect profit enhancing results within our businesses.
We expect the redemption to be completed on or about November 13, 2026.
Following the redemption, none of the November 2026 Notes will remain outstanding, and our track record of prepaying and repaying unsecured bondholders increases to $5.5 billion over 959 tranches.
We expect net proceeds of approximately $283.4 million after deducting estimated offering expenses.
We intend to use the net proceeds primarily to refinance existing indebtedness, including the November 2026 Notes and/or borrowings under the Revolving Credit Facility.
There can be no assurance that we will successfully consummate any investment opportunity we pursue.
